entities.summary: Škrda, or Otok Škrda, is an uninhabited Croatian island in the Adriatic Sea with an area of 2.05 km2, and 7.177 km of coastline, located southwest of Pag. British escort destroyer HMS Aldenham was sunk by a naval mine near the island in December 1944.
